system.description: After making a light unarmed attack, as an extra action on your turn you make another light unarmed attack against the same target or a different one. Action. At tier 3: You can make a third light unarmed attack as a third action on your turn. A few character abilities allow you to treat your unarmed attack as a medium weapon instead of a light weapon. You can't use Flurry with a medium unarmed attack.
